'''Camp Traken-4''', also known as '''Outpost Traken-4''', was a military installation of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] located on the [[Markaran Plains]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. It was originally known as the '''Traken-4 ChemWorks''', a chemical processing plant that was severely damaged by Imperial bombardment.
